      (() => {
        const html = document.documentElement;
        const navigation = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0];

        if (
          !html.classList.contains('hardware-kiosk-html') ||
          !['navigate', 'back_forward'].includes(navigation?.type) ||
          !document.referrer
        ) {
          return;
        }

        try {
          const referrer = new URL(document.referrer);
          const current = new URL(window.location.href);

          if (referrer.origin === current.origin && referrer.pathname !== current.pathname) {
            html.dataset.kioskNavigationIntro = 'pending';
          }
        } catch {
          return;
        }
      })();
    </script>
    <script>
      const q = [],
        u = [],
        pq = [],
        iq = [];

      window.Sq = window.Sq || {};
      window.Sq.Tracking = {
        cdpStatus: 'not_loaded', // config, script_load, success
        cdpLoaded: false, // used only for testing purposes and should not be referred to in code.
        queue: q,
        subscriptions: u,
        pageQueue: pq,
        identifyQueue: iq,

        track: (s, i) => {
          q.push(Object.assign({}, { data: s }, i ? { destinations: i.destinations } : {}));
        },
        trackExplicit: (s) => q.push(s),
        page: (i, e) => {
          pq.push(Object.assign({}, { data: i }, e ? { destinations: e.destinations } : {}));
        },
        pageExplicit: (i) => pq.push(i),
        identify: (i, e) => {
          iq.push(Object.assign({}, { data: i }, e ? { destinations: e.destinations } : {}));
        },
        subscribe(s, i) {
          u.push({ eventName: s, callback: i, type: 'subscribe' });
        },
        unsubscribe(s, i) {
          u.push({ eventName: s, callback: i, type: 'unsubscribe' });
        },
      };

      window.Sq.Tracking.subscribe('sq:cdpTrackerInitialized', () => {
        window.Sq.Tracking.cdpLoaded = true;
        window.Sq.Tracking.cdpStatus = 'success';
      });

      window.Sq.Tracking.subscribe('sq:cdpTrackerFailedInitialization', (ev) => {
        window.Sq.Tracking.cdpReason = `${ev.detail.reason}_issue`;
      });
    </script>

      var check = function () {
        var unsupportedBrowserModalEl = document.querySelector('.unsupported-browser-modal .ModalPartial');

        document.getElementById('unsupportedBrowser').hidden = false;
        var unsupportedBrowserModalCloseButtonEl = document.querySelector(
          '.unsupported-browser-modal .ModalPartial button'
        );
        unsupportedBrowserModalCloseButtonEl.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

        function closeModal() {
          var unsupportedBrowserModalEl = document.querySelector('.unsupported-browser-modal .ModalPartial');
          unsupportedBrowserModalEl.setAttribute('data-active', 'false');
          document.getElementById('unsupportedBrowser').hidden = true;
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
      };

      window.addEventListener('load', check);
    </script>

/* Monochrome theme: Buttons should have fully rounded borders (pill shape) */
[data-market-theme="monochrome"] #onetrust-consent-sdk button {
  border-radius: 1000px !important;
}

[data-market-theme="monochrome"] #onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item > button {
  border-radius: 6px !important;
}

/* Monochrome theme: Links should be underlined */

[data-market-theme="monochrome"] #ot-pc-desc a {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

/*
  This file relies heavily on !important because the OneTrust selectors
  are extremely specific and hard to override
*/

#onetrust-consent-sdk {
  font-family: var(--onetrust-font-family);
}

/* Give the modal some rounded edges */
#onetrust-pc-sdk.otPcCenter,
#onetrust-banner-sdk.otCenterRounded {
  border-radius: 12px !important;
}

/* The heading title no the Banner. Says 'Manage Cookies' */
#onetrust-policy-title {
  color: var(--onetrust-primary-text-color) !important;
  font-size: 24px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  line-height: 32px !important;
  padding-bottom: 24px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.003em !important;
}

/* Smaller headers found in the preference center for Cookie Preferences and Manage Cookie Preferences */
#ot-pc-title,
#ot-category-title {
  color: var(--onetrust-primary-text-color) !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
  line-height: 26px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.006em !important;
}

/* The text right below a heading. Usually found as <p> text */
#onetrust-policy-text,
#ot-pc-desc {
  color: var(--onetrust-secondary-text-color) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 22px !important;
}

#ot-pc-desc {
  font-size: 12px !important;
  line-height: 18px !important;
}

/* The style of links found in paragraph text */
#onetrust-policy-text a,
#ot-pc-desc a {
  color: var(--onetrust-hyperlink-color) !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  padding: 0px 6px !important;
  margin: 0px -6px !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
}

/* Spacing for the privacy link */
#ot-pc-desc a.privacy-notice-link + a.ot-imprint-handler {
  margin-left: 4px !important;
}

#onetrust-policy-text a {
  margin-left: 1px !important;
  margin-right: 1px !important;
}

/* The style of links in paragraph text when hovering */
#onetrust-policy-text a:hover,
#ot-pc-desc a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

/* The style of links in paragraph text when focusing */
#onetrust-policy-text a:focus,
#ot-pc-desc a:focus {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Primary button colours. All revolve around saving the cookies chosen */
#onetrust-accept-btn-handler,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-primary-button-bg-color) !important;
  color: var(--onetrust-primary-button-text-color) !important;
  border: none !important;
}

/* Primary button pressed. All revolve around saving the cookies chosen */
#onetrust-accept-btn-handler:active,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler:active,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler:active,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler:active,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:active {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-primary-button-pressed-color) !important;
  border: none !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Primary button hovers. All revolve around saving the cookies chosen */
#onetrust-accept-btn-handler:hover,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler:hover,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler:hover,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler:hover,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:hover {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-primary-button-hover-color) !important;
  border: none !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  outline: none !important;
}

#onetrust-accept-btn-handler:focus-visible,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler:focus-visible,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler:focus-visible,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler:focus-visible,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Primary button hovers. All revolve around saving the cookies chosen */
#onetrust-accept-btn-handler:focus,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler:focus,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler:focus,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler:focus,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus {
  border: none !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Secondary button colors */
#onetrust-pc-btn-handler {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-bg-color) !important;
  color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-text-color) !important;
  border: none !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

/* Secondary button hover colors */
#onetrust-pc-btn-handler:hover {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-hover-color) !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-btn-handler:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-btn-handler:focus {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Secondary button pressed colors */
#onetrust-pc-btn-handler:active {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-pressed-color) !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/*
  The button group on the main banner is awful. Using flexbox for a

*/
#onetrust-button-group {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row-reverse;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

/* General Button font sizes, styles, padding */
#onetrust-consent-sdk button {
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 22px !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  letter-spacing: normal !important;
}

#onetrust-accept-btn-handler,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler,
#onetrust-pc-btn-handler {
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 24px !important;
}

/*
  This defaults to 50% for some reason. It works much better when automatic
  This contains the primary success button
*/
#onetrust-banner-sdk .banner-actions-container {
  width: auto !important;
  display: flex !important;
}

/* This holds the main heading. This gives our modal more space at the top */
#onetrust-policy {
  margin-top: 32px !important;
}

/* Preference Center specific styles below */

/*
  The Strictly Necessary category has a special text that
  says 'Always Active' that is coloured differently
*/
.ot-always-active {
  color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-text-color) !important;
}

.ot-accordion-layout h4 ~ .ot-tgl {
  top: 55% !important;
}

/*
  The following are related to the toggle buttons in the accordian.
  There are different toggles for on and off
*/

/* This is the toggle button itself in each accordian. Here we are only adjusting the background color */
.ot-tgl input + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-bg-color) !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--onetrust-toggle-off-border-color) !important;
  transition: none;
  transition: border-color 0.25s !important;
}

/* This is the actual knob colour in the toggle button accordian */
.ot-tgl input + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob:before {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-knob-color) !important;
  border-color: none !important;

  width: 14px !important;
  height: 14px !important;
  bottom: 3px !important;
  left: 3px !important;
  transition-duration: 0.25s !important;
}

/* Hover colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:hover + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-hover-border-color) !important;
}

.ot-tgl input:hover + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob:before {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-hover-knob-color) !important;
}

/* Pressed colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:active + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-pressed-border-color) !important;
}

.ot-tgl input:active + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob:before {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-pressed-knob-color) !important;
}

/* Focus colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:focus,
.ot-tgl input:focus + .ot-switch,
.ot-tgl input:focus + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  outline: none !important;
}

.ot-tgl input:focus-visible + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Toggled states for the toggles in the accordians */
.ot-tgl input:checked + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-bg-color) !important;
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-border-color) !important;
}

.ot-tgl input:checked + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob:before {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-knob-color) !important;
  border-color: none !important;
}

/* Hover colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:checked:hover + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-hover-bg-color) !important;
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-hover-border-color) !important;
}

/* Pressed colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:checked:active + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-pressed-bg-color) !important;
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-pressed-border-color) !important;
}

/* Accordian button styles */
.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-plus-minus span {
  background: var(--onetrust-primary-text-color) !important;
}

.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button:hover + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-plus-minus span,
.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button:focus-visible + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-plus-minus span {
  background: var(--onetrust-accordian-hover-color) !important;
}

.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button:hover + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-cat-header,
.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button:focus-visible + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-cat-header {
  color: var(--onetrust-accordian-hover-color) !important;
}

/* The name of the cookie categories. Making the font too large breaks the layout */
.ot-cat-header {
  color: var(--onetrust-primary-text-color) !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 22px !important;
}

/* Override the accordian headers, allowing it to fill the screen */
.ot-acc-hdr {
  padding: 15px 0px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* The description text within each accordian dropdown */
.ot-acc-grpdesc.ot-category-desc {
  color: var(--onetrust-secondary-text-color) !important;
  margin-top: 0px !important;
  padding-left: 25px !important;
  padding-right: 15px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  line-height: 18px !important;
}

/* Each accordian text has a background colour. This allows it to be adjustable */
.ot-acc-grpcntr.ot-acc-txt {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-accordian-bg-color) !important;
}

/* Overwriting the accordian borders for a cleaner layout */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item {
  border: none !important;
}

/*
  Add a box shadow to the top of each accordian except the first one.
  If we add it to the bottom of each one, it disappears on expansion.
*/
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item:not(:first-of-type) {
  box-shadow: inset 0px 1px 0px var(--onetrust-accordian-divider-color) !important;
}

/* There is a button in each accordian to handle clicks. Make it extend the full width */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item > button {
  padding-right: 0px !important;
}

/* Override focus outline of these buttons */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item > button:focus {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout h4 ~ .ot-always-active {
  right: 10px !important;
}

/*
  We're removing the OneTrust footer, which forces us to re-align the main content
  because their whole UI is so carefully positioned
*/
#onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-pc-content {
  bottom: 85px !important;

  /* Allow outlines to go out of the div */
  margin-left: 0px !important;
  padding-left: 30px !important;
}

/*
  The bottom Confirmation button. We're adjusting the placement
  which requires shifting for some padding
*/
.save-preference-btn-handler {
  margin-left: 32px !important;
  margin-top: 19px !important;
  margin-bottom: 19px !important;
  float: left !important;
}

/* The close button */
#close-pc-btn-handler.ot-close-icon {
  background-image: var(--onetrust-close-icon) !important;
  background-size: 10px !important;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  top: 14px;
  right: 14px;
  margin-right: 8px !important;
  margin-top: 2px !important;
}

#close-pc-btn-handler.ot-close-icon:focus {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Close button hovers */
#close-pc-btn-handler.ot-close-icon:hover {
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* There are a few border colors that we will be overriding */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-header {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--onetrust-layout-border-color) !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--onetrust-layout-border-color) !important;
}

/*
  General styling changes for smaller screens. The OneTrust CSS itself uses
  this media query. In general, the buttons must grow to fill the modal
  in this view
*/
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #onetrust-pc-sdk.otPcCenter {
    border-radius: 0px !important;
  }

  #onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-pc-content {
    /* Allow outlines to go out of the div */
    margin-left: 0px !important;
    padding-left: 13px !important;
  }

  #close-pc-btn-handler.ot-close-icon {
    width: unset !important;
    margin-right: 6px !important;
  }

  /* This grouping must be adjusted for smaller screens to stack vertically */
  #onetrust-button-group {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
  }

  /* This container must grow to 100% to fill the modal */
  #onetrust-banner-sdk .banner-actions-container {
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  /* All buttons must attempt to grow to the size of the modal */
  #onetrust-consent-sdk button {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
  }

  /* Fix broken margins on narrow screens from OneTrust */
  #onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-btn-handler {
    margin-right: 0px !important;
  }

  /*
    This is broken in general on narrow screens with OneTrust
    This legitimately fixes it to center it on mobile
  */
  #onetrust-consent-sdk button.save-preference-btn-handler {
    margin-left: 10px !important;
    margin-right: 10px !important;
    width: calc(100% - 20px) !important;
  }
}

/* Hide logos */
.ot-pc-logo,
.ot-pc-footer-logo {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Monochrome theme: Links should be underlined */
[data-market-theme="monochrome"] #onetrust-policy-text a,
[data-market-theme="monochrome"] #ot-pc-desc a {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

/*
  This file relies heavily on !important because the OneTrust selectors
  are extremely specific and hard to override
*/

#onetrust-consent-sdk {
  font-family: var(--onetrust-font-family);
}

/* Give the modal some rounded edges */
#onetrust-pc-sdk.otPcCenter,
#onetrust-banner-sdk.otCenterRounded {
  border-radius: 12px !important;
}

/* The heading title no the Banner. Says 'Manage Cookies' */
#onetrust-policy-title {
  color: var(--onetrust-primary-text-color) !important;
  font-size: 24px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  line-height: 32px !important;
  padding-bottom: 24px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.003em !important;
}

/* Smaller headers found in the preference center for Cookie Preferences and Manage Cookie Preferences */
#ot-pc-title,
#ot-category-title {
  color: var(--onetrust-primary-text-color) !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
  line-height: 26px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.006em !important;
}

/* The text right below a heading. Usually found as <p> text */
#onetrust-policy-text,
#ot-pc-desc {
  color: var(--onetrust-secondary-text-color) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 22px !important;
}

#ot-pc-desc {
  font-size: 12px !important;
  line-height: 18px !important;
}

/* The style of links found in paragraph text */
#onetrust-policy-text a,
#ot-pc-desc a {
  color: var(--onetrust-hyperlink-color) !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  padding: 0px 6px !important;
  margin: 0px -6px !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
}

/* Spacing for the privacy link */
#ot-pc-desc a.privacy-notice-link + a.ot-imprint-handler {
  margin-left: 4px !important;
}

#onetrust-policy-text a {
  margin-left: 1px !important;
  margin-right: 1px !important;
}

/* The style of links in paragraph text when hovering */
#onetrust-policy-text a:hover,
#ot-pc-desc a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

/* The style of links in paragraph text when focusing */
#onetrust-policy-text a:focus,
#ot-pc-desc a:focus {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Primary button colours. All revolve around saving the cookies chosen */
#onetrust-accept-btn-handler,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-primary-button-bg-color) !important;
  color: var(--onetrust-primary-button-text-color) !important;
  border: none !important;
}

/* Primary button pressed. All revolve around saving the cookies chosen */
#onetrust-accept-btn-handler:active,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler:active,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler:active,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler:active,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:active {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-primary-button-pressed-color) !important;
  border: none !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Primary button hovers. All revolve around saving the cookies chosen */
#onetrust-accept-btn-handler:hover,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler:hover,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler:hover,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler:hover,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:hover {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-primary-button-hover-color) !important;
  border: none !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  outline: none !important;
}

#onetrust-accept-btn-handler:focus-visible,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler:focus-visible,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler:focus-visible,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler:focus-visible,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Primary button hovers. All revolve around saving the cookies chosen */
#onetrust-accept-btn-handler:focus,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler:focus,
#accept-recommended-btn-handler:focus,
.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler:focus,
.save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus {
  border: none !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Secondary button colors */
#onetrust-pc-btn-handler {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-bg-color) !important;
  color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-text-color) !important;
  border: none !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

/* Secondary button hover colors */
#onetrust-pc-btn-handler:hover {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-hover-color) !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-btn-handler:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-btn-handler:focus {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Secondary button pressed colors */
#onetrust-pc-btn-handler:active {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-pressed-color) !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/*
  The button group on the main banner is awful. Using flexbox for a
  superior layout at all screen sizes
*/
#onetrust-button-group {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row-reverse;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

/* General Button font sizes, styles, padding */
#onetrust-consent-sdk button {
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 22px !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  letter-spacing: normal !important;
}

#onetrust-accept-btn-handler,
#onetrust-reject-all-handler,
#onetrust-pc-btn-handler {
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 24px !important;
}

/*
  This defaults to 50% for some reason. It works much better when automatic
  This contains the primary success button
*/
#onetrust-banner-sdk .banner-actions-container {
  width: auto !important;
  display: flex !important;
}

/* This holds the main heading. This gives our modal more space at the top */
#onetrust-policy {
  margin-top: 32px !important;
}

/* Preference Center specific styles below */

/*
  The Strictly Necessary category has a special text that
  says 'Always Active' that is coloured differently
*/
.ot-always-active {
  color: var(--onetrust-secondary-button-text-color) !important;
}

.ot-accordion-layout h4 ~ .ot-tgl {
  top: 55% !important;
}

/*
  The following are related to the toggle buttons in the accordian.
  There are different toggles for on and off
*/

/* This is the toggle button itself in each accordian. Here we are only adjusting the background color */
.ot-tgl input + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-bg-color) !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--onetrust-toggle-off-border-color) !important;
  transition: none;
  transition: border-color 0.25s !important;
}

/* This is the actual knob colour in the toggle button accordian */
.ot-tgl input + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob:before {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-knob-color) !important;
  border-color: none !important;

  width: 14px !important;
  height: 14px !important;
  bottom: 3px !important;
  left: 3px !important;
  transition-duration: 0.25s !important;
}

/* Hover colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:hover + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-hover-border-color) !important;
}

.ot-tgl input:hover + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob:before {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-hover-knob-color) !important;
}

/* Pressed colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:active + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-pressed-border-color) !important;
}

.ot-tgl input:active + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob:before {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-off-pressed-knob-color) !important;
}

/* Focus colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:focus,
.ot-tgl input:focus + .ot-switch,
.ot-tgl input:focus + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  outline: none !important;
}

.ot-tgl input:focus-visible + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Toggled states for the toggles in the accordians */
.ot-tgl input:checked + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-bg-color) !important;
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-border-color) !important;
}

.ot-tgl input:checked + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob:before {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-knob-color) !important;
  border-color: none !important;
}

/* Hover colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:checked:hover + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-hover-bg-color) !important;
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-hover-border-color) !important;
}

/* Pressed colors for toggle off */
.ot-tgl input:checked:active + .ot-switch .ot-switch-nob {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-pressed-bg-color) !important;
  border-color: var(--onetrust-toggle-on-pressed-border-color) !important;
}

/* Accordian button styles */
.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-plus-minus span {
  background: var(--onetrust-primary-text-color) !important;
}

.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button:hover + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-plus-minus span,
.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button:focus-visible + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-plus-minus span {
  background: var(--onetrust-accordian-hover-color) !important;
}

.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button:hover + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-cat-header,
.ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item button:focus-visible + .ot-acc-hdr .ot-cat-header {
  color: var(--onetrust-accordian-hover-color) !important;
}

/* The name of the cookie categories. Making the font too large breaks the layout */
.ot-cat-header {
  color: var(--onetrust-primary-text-color) !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 22px !important;
}

/* Override the accordian headers, allowing it to fill the screen */
.ot-acc-hdr {
  padding: 15px 0px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* The description text within each accordian dropdown */
.ot-acc-grpdesc.ot-category-desc {
  color: var(--onetrust-secondary-text-color) !important;
  margin-top: 0px !important;
  padding-left: 25px !important;
  padding-right: 15px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  line-height: 18px !important;
}

/* Each accordian text has a background colour. This allows it to be adjustable */
.ot-acc-grpcntr.ot-acc-txt {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-accordian-bg-color) !important;
}

/* Overwriting the accordian borders for a cleaner layout */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item {
  border: none !important;
}

/*
  Add a box shadow to the top of each accordian except the first one.
  If we add it to the bottom of each one, it disappears on expansion.
*/
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item:not(:first-of-type) {
  box-shadow: inset 0px 1px 0px var(--onetrust-accordian-divider-color) !important;
}

/* There is a button in each accordian to handle clicks. Make it extend the full width */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item > button {
  padding-right: 0px !important;
}

/* Override focus outline of these buttons */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout.ot-cat-item > button:focus {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-accordion-layout h4 ~ .ot-always-active {
  right: 10px !important;
}

/*
  We're removing the OneTrust footer, which forces us to re-align the main content
  because their whole UI is so carefully positioned
*/
#onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-pc-content {
  bottom: 85px !important;

  /* Allow outlines to go out of the div */
  margin-left: 0px !important;
  padding-left: 30px !important;
}

/*
  The bottom Confirmation button. We're adjusting the placement
  which requires shifting for some padding
*/
.save-preference-btn-handler {
  margin-left: 32px !important;
  margin-top: 19px !important;
  margin-bottom: 19px !important;
  float: left !important;
}

/* The close button */
#close-pc-btn-handler.ot-close-icon {
  background-image: var(--onetrust-close-icon) !important;
  background-size: 10px !important;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  top: 14px;
  right: 14px;
  margin-right: 8px !important;
  margin-top: 2px !important;
}

#close-pc-btn-handler.ot-close-icon:focus {
  outline: var(--onetrust-focus-outline) !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Close button hovers */
#close-pc-btn-handler.ot-close-icon:hover {
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* There are a few border colors that we will be overriding */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-header {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--onetrust-layout-border-color) !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--onetrust-layout-border-color) !important;
}

/*
  General styling changes for smaller screens. The OneTrust CSS itself uses
  this media query. In general, the buttons must grow to fill the modal
  in this view
*/
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #onetrust-pc-sdk.otPcCenter {
    border-radius: 0px !important;
  }

  #onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-pc-content {
    /* Allow outlines to go out of the div */
    margin-left: 0px !important;
    padding-left: 13px !important;
  }

  #close-pc-btn-handler.ot-close-icon {
    width: unset !important;
    margin-right: 6px !important;
  }

  /* This grouping must be adjusted for smaller screens to stack vertically */
  #onetrust-button-group {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
  }

  /* This container must grow to 100% to fill the modal */
  #onetrust-banner-sdk .banner-actions-container {
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  /* All buttons must attempt to grow to the size of the modal */
  #onetrust-consent-sdk button {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
  }

  /* Fix broken margins on narrow screens from OneTrust */
  #onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-btn-handler {
    margin-right: 0px !important;
  }

  /*
    This is broken in general on narrow screens with OneTrust
    This legitimately fixes it to center it on mobile
  */
  #onetrust-consent-sdk button.save-preference-btn-handler {
    margin-left: 10px !important;
    margin-right: 10px !important;
    width: calc(100% - 20px) !important;
  }
}

/* Hide logos */
.ot-pc-logo,
.ot-pc-footer-logo {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Background color overrides. These selectors were taken straight from OneTrust*/
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-banner-sdk,
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk,
#onetrust-consent-sdk #ot-search-cntr,
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-switch.ot-toggle,
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-grp-hdr1 .checkbox,
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-pc-title:after,
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-sel-blk,
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-fltr-cnt,
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-anchor {
  background-color: var(--onetrust-bg-color) !important;
